about: One hour of shadow reporting: what answer engines told a reader, split into checkable statements in our own words and compared with this site's record. An engine's answer is evidence about the engine, not about the storm. The answers' full text is not here (raw store, outside git: the pointer and sha256 are).

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The engine did not search
statements.note: the question it answered in the five rounds before

answers.told: No answer: it asked whether the storm in the news was meant, and for which dates.

answers.question: charles-lisbon

statements.text: The Lisbon district is under a red warning
statements.note: no red warning anywhere on the mainland since 15:55

statements.text: Flooding and dozens of overnight incidents in Lisbon
"Expected to", strongest "around midday to late afternoon", the track "still uncertain"
statements.note: at 17:07 Lisbon was easing: rain 0 to 1.2 mm in the hour, pressure flat

answers.told: Yes, "expected to be hit"; the district "under a red warning"; impacts already felt; the track still uncertain.

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.asked: A tempestade Charles vai atingir Lisboa?

statements.text: Less impact in Lisbon than first forecast, above all in wind; the track moved south
IPMA placed Lisbon under red for rain and wind, gusts "initially" forecast at 120 to 140 km/h
statements.note: marked as initial, correctly

statements.text: Floods in the city, cars partly submerged by Oriente station

answers.told: Yes, it is affecting Lisbon, less than first forecast, above all in wind; floods recorded, cars partly submerged near Oriente.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: What warnings are in force in Lisbon now?
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: Yellow rain to 18:00; orange sea to 21:00 (5 to 7 metres, up to 13); yellow sea 21:00 to 03:00
statements.note: the first answer in six rounds with no red and with every window; it names "the local weather service feed" and gives no address at all

statements.text: Orange wind in effect until 18:00, gusts up to about 90 km/h, possibly 110
statements.note: IPMA's text of 12:33, exactly; IPMA ended this warning at 15:56, 71 minutes before the answer (its own open data still showed it at 16:24)

answers.told: Orange wind to 18:00 (90, up to 110 km/h); orange sea to 21:00; yellow rain to 18:00; yellow sea 21:00 to 03:00. No red.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: What warnings are in force in Lisbon now?

statements.text: A red rain warning is in force for Lisbon
statements.note: ended at 15:00, two hours before

statements.text: An orange wind warning, gusts up to 120 km/h
statements.note: IPMA ended it at 15:56; the 120 km/h text was replaced at 12:33

statements.text: Orange sea warning, south-west waves 5 to 7 metres, up to 13
A yellow rain warning "starting later in the afternoon"
statements.note: it is the one in force since 15:00

answers.told: Red rain, orange wind (gusts to 120 km/h), orange and yellow sea; a yellow rain warning "later".

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: Que avisos estão em vigor em Lisboa agora?

statements.text: A red rain warning in force until 18:00
statements.note: the window IPMA replaced at 12:33; nothing red since 15:00

statements.text: An orange wind warning in force until 21:00
statements.note: shortened to 18:00 at 12:33 and ended at 15:56

statements.text: The alert situation to 23:59; tunnels and fenced gardens closed

answers.told: Red rain until 18:00 and orange wind until 21:00; the alert situation to 23:59; tunnels and gardens closed.

479 litres per square metre in 12 hours, above February 2010

answers.told: Charles: 479 litres per square metre in 12 hours; about 210 occurrences to 09:00 and nearly 285 by early afternoon; no deaths; a man rescued alive.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: Tomorrow, 12 November, is a conference day; Wednesday cancelled on the government's advice
Organisers "aim to resume" on Thursday with rescheduled sessions
statements.note: the rescheduling is today's news; "aim to" is Tuesday's word

answers.told: Yes: tomorrow, 12 November, is a conference day; Wednesday was cancelled; organisers "aim to" hold the final day with rescheduled sessions.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow

statements.text: Yes, tomorrow is Thursday 12 November and the summit resumes for its final day, confirmed by organisers and news reports
statements.note: the first Sonar answer that is right in its first word, its date and its news, five hours after the press reported the confirmation

statements.text: The official schedule lists Thursday's sessions

answers.told: Yes: scheduled to run tomorrow, Thursday 12 November, the final day; Wednesday was cancelled; organisers and news reports confirm it resumes.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow

statements.text: "Amanhã (quarta-feira)" at 17:07 on Wednesday: No
statements.note: the same engine at the same minute answered Yes in English: the two languages now disagree

statements.text: The conference resumes on Thursday 12 November, its last day

answers.told: No: it does not take place "tomorrow (Wednesday)"; it resumes on Thursday 12 November, the last day.

websummit-tomorrow.text: Web Summit's own page (Tuesday 19:09): Day 2 off, Day 3 "aims to proceed". The press: Thursday confirmed by the organisers' message to participants (from about 12:00); many of Wednesday's sessions rescheduled, a press conference on Thursday at 11:00 (16:28). Not read by us at the organisers' page.

lisbon-warnings.text: IPMA: red rain ended 15:00; the orange wind was ended early at 15:56. In force at 17:07: yellow rain to 18:00, orange sea to 21:00 (then yellow to 03:00). No red warning anywhere on the mainland since 15:55. The alert situation to 23:59.

charles-lisbon.text: IPMA's communiqué no. 3 (12:16): the low split in two, weaker wind. Observed: rain down to 0 to 1.2 mm in the hour to 15:00; the airport at 16:00 south-south-west 39 km/h, 989 hPa flat; the day's highest gust 74 km/h at 14:00.

metro.text: The mayor (Tuesday): the Metro runs on Wednesday; no service notice on the Metro's own site at 11:52. CP (15:30 update): the Campolide to Alcântara Terra suppression stands; the Beira Baixa line interrupted.

madeira.text: IPMA: red warnings ended 06:00; Areeiro 249.5 mm in six hours, 474.7 in twelve. Regional civil protection, relayed by Lusa: 285 occurrences to about 13:00.
